claims: NASA successfully launched the Artemis II mission on April 1, 2026.
The Artemis II mission sent four astronauts on a 10-day crewed flight around the Moon.
The Artemis II crew launched from Kennedy Space Center.
The Artemis II crew launched on the SLS rocket.
Reid Wiseman is the commander of the Artemis II crew.
Victor Glover is the pilot of the Artemis II crew.
Christina Koch is the mission specialist of the Artemis II crew.
Jeremy Hansen is the CSA specialist of the Artemis II crew.
The Artemis II crew features the first woman, Christina Koch, to travel to the Moon.
The Artemis II crew features the first person of color, Victor Glover, to travel to the Moon.
The Artemis II crew features the first Canadian, Jeremy Hansen, to travel to the Moon.
Artemis II is the first crewed flight of the Orion spacecraft.
Artemis II tests the Orion spacecraft's life support systems.
The Space Launch System (SLS) rocket lifted off from Launch Complex 39B.
The Space Launch System (SLS) rocket is the most powerful in the world.
The Artemis II mission involves a lunar flyby.
The Artemis II crew returns and splashes down in the Pacific Ocean.
The Artemis II mission follows the uncrewed Artemis I flight
